relations: A gentle breeze sways the tall reeds along the right shoreline, sending small ripples across the calm water surface.
If wind increases, the mirrored tree reflections on the lake break into shimmering, distorted patterns.
Drifting clouds move slowly across the blue sky, their faint reflections shifting on the water below.
The still water surface persists as a mirror unless disturbed by wind or movement along the shore.
